Dear Colleagues,
Hope you are doing great.
We have received an issue stating that the main breaker QA1 has tripped. We kindly request you to coordinate a site intervention for this charger. Please adhere to the troubleshooting steps outlined in the attached document. Additionally, if feasible, arrange for spare components so that if the current ones are damaged, we can replace them and restore the charger to operational status.
